name: Sarah
heroSubheading: Today is all about celebrating the wonderful person you are.

letter.body:
Every single day spent knowing you has been an absolute gift. Your laughter lights up every room, your kindness touches every heart, and your love makes the world a better place.

From the very first moment we met, I knew you were someone truly extraordinary. You have this magical ability to make everyone around you feel seen, valued, and loved.

On this special day, I want you to know just how deeply you are appreciated, cherished, and adored. You deserve every beautiful thing this world has to offer.

Happy Birthday, my love. Here's to another incredible year of adventures, laughter, and endless joy together.

photos.caption: The best is yet to come 🌟

timeline.title: The Day We First Met
timeline.description: It was a perfectly ordinary day that turned into something extraordinary. Little did I know that meeting you would change everything.

timeline.title: Our First Adventure
timeline.description: We packed our bags and hit the road without a plan. Every turn was a surprise, every moment a new memory. The best trip ever.

timeline.title: That Perfect Evening
timeline.description: Under the stars, with our favorite song playing softly in the background. A moment frozen in time that I'll treasure forever.

timeline.title: A Special Celebration
timeline.description: Surrounded by the people who love you most, your joy was infectious. Watching you be celebrated was one of the happiest moments of my life.

timeline.title: Your Special Birthday 🎂
timeline.description: Another year of growth, love, and beautiful moments. Today we celebrate YOU — the most amazing person I know.

specialReasons.title: Your Smile
specialReasons.message: Your smile has the power to light up the darkest room and lift the heaviest heart. It's the first thing I think of when I think of you, and it makes every single day brighter.

specialReasons.title: Your Kindness
specialReasons.message: The way you treat others with such genuine care and compassion is truly rare. You see the best in people and bring it out in them. The world is kinder because of you.

specialReasons.title: Your Strength
specialReasons.message: You face every challenge with incredible grace and resilience. Watching you overcome obstacles inspires me every single day. You are stronger than you know.

specialReasons.title: Your Humor
specialReasons.message: Life is so much more fun with you in it. Your laugh is contagious, your wit is sharp, and your ability to find joy in everything makes every moment an adventure.

specialReasons.title: Your Support
specialReasons.message: No matter what happens, you are always there. Your unwavering support means more than words can express. I am so grateful to have you in my corner.

specialReasons.title: Your Magic
specialReasons.message: There is something magical about you that is impossible to describe but impossible to ignore. You make ordinary moments feel extraordinary, and that is a truly special gift.

slideshow.caption: Every moment with you is a treasure 💕
Here's to a lifetime of adventures ✨

birthdayWish: Close your eyes, make a wish, and believe with all your heart. Everything you dream of is possible. ✨

giftBox.title: A Special Surprise! 🎁
giftBox.message:
Every day with you is a gift. But today, I want to give something back — my promise to always be here, to always make you smile, and to always make you feel as loved as you truly are.

Happy Birthday, my love. You deserve all the magic in the world. 💖
